Vulnerability and bug detection

Changes in PR

1 file+22

testing-library/react checks Object.hasOwnProperty.call(setTimeout, 'clock') to detect if fake timers are active. Without this marker, it never calls jest.advanceTimersByTime().

New helper :

zig
fn setFakeTimerMarker(  globalObject,   enabled: bool) void {  const setTimeout_fn = /* globalThis.setTimeout */;  // setTimeout.clock = enabled  setTimeout_fn.put(    globalObject,     "clock",     JSValue.jsBoolean(enabled)  );}

Called with true in useFakeTimers() and false in useRealTimers() .

1 file+5−1

Per the HTML spec, setTimeout(fn, 0) is internally scheduled with a 1ms delay. This meant:

javascript
setTimeout(() => console.log("hi"), 0);jest.advanceTimersByTime(0);// "hi" never logged - timer is at 1ms!

The fix treats advanceTimersByTime(0) as advancing by 1ms :

zig
// Before:const target = current.addMsFloat(arg_number);// After:const effective_advance =   if (arg_number == 0) 1 else arg_number;const target = current.addMsFloat(effective_advance);

1 file+62

Tests validate both fixes:

  • setTimeout.clock marker is set/unset correctly
  • advanceTimersByTime(0) fires immediate timers
  • The user-event wait pattern no longer hangs

1 file+9

Adds a password-change route to the account service so users can update their credentials.

Every code review is now a security review.

Security criticalAuth BypassCWE-862R112-119
PUKU
Password-change endpoint lacks ownership or admin authorization checks

The new POST /api/users/password handler accepts any username and password after secureFnc, but never verifies that the authenticated request user is the same account (or an admin) before calling setUsers. In this codebase verifyToken also creates a guest token when no x-access-token is supplied (), so an unauthenticated/guest request can reach this handler and reset any known user's password, resulting in account takeover.

Recommendation

Require a valid authenticated non-guest user for this route, verify req.userId === req.body.username for self-service changes (or require admin permission for resets), and verify the current password before writing the new password. Reject guest/unauthenticated requests and avoid disclosing whether arbitrary usernames exist if possible.

Automated vulnerability detection

PUKU automatically reviews every PR for vulnerabilities, reasoning across your entire codebase to catch the auth bypasses and logic flaws that pattern-matching scanners miss.

Severity ranking and CWE tagging

Each finding is ranked by severity and tagged with a CWE ID for easy triaging.

Merge-ready fixes

Beyond flagging issues, PUKU writes the fix directly and opens it as a merge-ready PR, so it arrives ready for an engineer to review instead of a ticket that waits weeks in a queue.

Copy/move detection

Automatically detects when code is moved or copied, and shows you where it came from.
